Q: Updating Git for Windows unattended with PowerShell returns an error when run against remote servers A:

My debugging order would be:

  1. Redirect stdout/stderr to files.

  2. Check child processes while the remoting call is hanging.

  3. Run the updater with Start-Process and redirected handles.

  4. Compare PowerShell versions locally/remotely.

  5. Test with a current PowerShell 7 version.

  6. If the issue persists, inspect WinRM/event logs and the Git updater/installer process tree.

Q: What programming language or framework would you recommend for cross-platform mobile development on Android and iOS? A:

I would recommend Flutter for a new cross-platform app.

The number of open GitHub issues alone is not an indication that Flutter is being abandoned the large actively developed projects can have thousands of open issues.

React Native is also a valid choice, especially if you already have experience with TypeScript and JavaScript . UI responsiveness and platform specific adjustments are contemplation with any cross-platform framework.

Ultimately choose based on the project requirements and the technologies your team is already familiar with.

Q: Move files from S3 to AWS EFS on the fly A:

Trigger a Lambda to call an ECS task when the file is uploaded to s3. The ECS task starts and mounts the EFS volume and copies the file from s3 to the EFS. This wont run into problems with really large files with Lambda getting timed out. I dont have the code but would be interested if someone already has this solution coded.

Q: (click) passing iteration variable and [class.selected] passing function A:

This is an example of parent-child communication in angular2.

When you are using (click)='clicked(myProduct)' event, what essentially you are doing is emitting the value of the selected product using @ouput onProductSelected property as shown here :

this.onProductSelected.emit(product);
$event` here would be equivalent to `#myProduct.value

When any event gets executed, angular2's change detections kicks-in; checking all the template expression values. It then updates the property binding as per value changes. now everytime value of myProduct changes, the property binding [class.selected] need to get updated , hence isSelected method gets called.

Q: boolean array and variant type vba A:

On edit: In the code for SetFlag I now create or extend the array if need be.

The problem is that the Get returns a copy of the private array -- so the code using the class changes a copy of the private array rather than the private array itself. A workaround is to provide methods to access the array. For example, in your class definition add this (I didn't know the name of the class so I made it Employee):

Public Sub SetFlag(i As Long, b As Boolean)
    If Not IsArray(errors) Then
        ReDim errors(0 To i) As Boolean
    ElseIf UBound(errors) < i Then
        ReDim Preserve errors(LBound(errors) To i) As Boolean
    End If
    errors(i) = b
End Sub   

Public Function GetFlag(i As Long) As Boolean
    GetFlag = errors(i)
End Function

A test sub:

Sub test()
    Dim b(1 To 4) As Boolean
    Dim e As New Employee
    b(1) = False
    b(2) = True
    b(3) = True
    b(4) = False

    e.setErrors = b
    Debug.Print e.hasErrors()(3) 'prints True
    e.hasErrors()(3) = False
    Debug.Print e.hasErrors()(3) '*Still* prints True

    'but:
    e.SetFlag 3, False
    Debug.Print e.hasErrors()(3) 'now prints False
    'or just:
    Debug.Print e.GetFlag(3) 'Prints False   
End Sub

Q: sbt-jacoco counting synthetic methods A:

Apparently, this was indeed a bug, that you raised in https://github.com/sbt/sbt-jacoco/issues/393 and was also already part of https://github.com/sbt/sbt-jacoco/issues/294 -- I submitted a patch that should fix it: https://github.com/sbt/sbt-jacoco/pull/469 -- it has been merged and I expect the issue to go away in the next release.
